findings.title: Receipt replay may open DB without the per-open ACL validation required by the contract
findings.evidence: §42 requires ACL verification before each open. §§47/52 check receipt before ACL/key validation and defer ACL checks to receipt-miss. §93 ACL tests only assert rejection before Prepare, which receipt replay does not call.
findings.required_change: Specify ACL/canonical identity validation before DB receipt open while keeping receipt-first precedence over sidecar checks; test valid receipt plus weakened ACL or path swap and assert no receipt disclosure/no planner or registry calls. Or explicitly justify and test a scoped exception.

findings.title: Cleanup failure isolation and non-reuse are specified but not exercised
findings.evidence: §42 says cleanup failure isolates the case and forbids reuse. §93 covers nominal retention and grouped deletion, but no failed-delete injection or partial-cleanup recovery assertion.
findings.required_change: Inject undeletable/locked DB, WAL, sidecar, or key file; prove cleanup failure quarantines the case, blocks requests/reuse, and never overwrites residual artifacts with a fresh key; specify deterministic retry/quarantine behavior.
